clips.title: The story
paras: Darkshire depends on Althea Ebonlocke and the Night Watch to hold Duskwood’s horrors at bay. A relative of Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, she leads the town guard in an isolated region left without Stormwind’s regular troops.

Althea Ebonlocke directs Darkshire’s defense while her relative, Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, governs from the town hall. When Stormwind sent no royal troops to guard Duskwood from its horrors, the townspeople formed the Night Watch. Under Althea’s firm command, its volunteers patrol the foggy roads and keep undead skeletons, fierce wolves, and spiders from overrunning the town’s edge.

Althea knows how little her militia can do alone. Recruits are scarce, and the Watch keeps losing them, so she enlists passing mercenaries and travelers to thin the threats near Darkshire. She directs efforts against ghouls and skeletons in the forest’s quiet, sorrowful graveyards, while watching for darker rumors from deep in the woods.
